doc.title: Frank Wess interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 29, 1995

title: Recommending Eric Dixon on tenor
summary: Wess, playing third alto, told Basie to hire Eric Dixon as tenor.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: Yeah, I told him to call Eric because you know I was playing third alto, and he put me there because he knew I could play first if Marshall wasn’t there, you know, he always kept somebody in the third chair that could play lead, so that he would never be without a lead player, you know. So he kept changing, looking for a tenor player, and it was bugging me, you know, because I’d played the book for what five or six years, you know what I mean? I knew what it was supposed to be. And he got all these people coming and I says “man, look, you better get you a tenor player.” He says, “Who can I call?” I says, “call Eric Dixon.” So he called him and he stayed there.
